          About this item

          • Apple Find My Global Tracking Network：CREASO Tracker Tag 4 pack work exclusively with iOS Apple Find My, using a global network of hundreds of millions of Apple devices for secure, anonymous long-distance tracking. No SIM card or monthly fees required
          • Precise Nearby Item Finding with Loud Alert：Within Bluetooth range (~60m/200ft), trigger a loud built-in buzzer up to 100dB to quickly locate nearby items. Use the Find My app to easily find keys, wallet, luggage, or backpack
          • Instant Left-Behind Alerts and Lost Mode：Get instant iPhone notifications when your item is left behind or disconnected. Enable Lost Mode to securely share contact info so nearby Apple devices can help return it
          • Ultra-Long Battery Life with Replaceable Battery：Powered by a low-energy chip and replaceable CR2032 battery, lasting up to 2 years. Comes with 4 pre-installed batteries plus 2 extra (6 total). No charging needed—just replace when required
          • Privacy-First Encryption Protection：All location data is sent via Apple Find My network with end-to-end encryption and anonymous identifiers. Your location history is never stored or shared
          • Waterproof and Reliable Build：Designed to resist dust and rain for everyday durability. Ideal for travel and securing keys, bags, luggage, and other essentials
          • Easy One-Tap Setup and Family Sharing (iOS 17+)：Quick pairing via the Find My app with no extra software needed. Supports sharing with up to 5 people for easy family or trusted-user tracking

          Product description

          Smart Bluetooth Tracker Tag: Total Protection, Never Lose a Thing

          Purpose-built for the Apple ecosystem and officially Apple MFi Certified, this smart tag integrates seamlessly with the Apple "Find My" network. Enjoy top-tier location tracking and privacy protection wherever you go.

          Track It Anywhere: Precision Global Location, No Matter the Distance

          No GPS signals or monthly cellular plans needed.

          If it's far away, you can still find it.By utilizing the vast Find My network made up of hundreds of millions of Apple devices worldwide, As long as there are Apple devices nearby, you can precisely pinpoint the updated location of your items on a map.

          Loud 100dB Sound Alert: Find Your Things in Seconds

          Keys lost in the sofa cushions? Can't find your wallet before heading to work?

          With a single tap on your phone, the tracker tag emits a crisp, loud 100dB beep that pierces through noisy environments and thick fabrics to help you locate hidden items quickly.

          Smart Left-Behind Reminder: Stop Losses Before They Happen

          If you accidentally leave your wallet, keys, or important belongings at a cafe or on the street, your iPhone will instantly send you an "Item Left Behind" notification the moment you step out of Bluetooth range.

          Connect to the Apple Ecosystem in 3 Simple Steps

          Secure Lost Mode & High-Grade Privacy Protection

          Activate "Lost Mode" to lock your tag to your Apple ID and leave a contact message for whoever find.

          Let Loved Ones Help You Keep Track

          Q:Can it be used to track pets?

          A:This item tracker can be used to track pets. If you have cats or dogs, you can attach it to your pet’s collar using the included key ring or lanyard.

          Q:Is it easy to set up?

          A:Yes, it’s easy to set up. Just turn on Bluetooth, open Apple’s Find My app, long-press the device’s power button until it beeps, and pair. See our product images for guidance.

          Q:Is the battery replaceable?

          A:Our Air Tracker Tags use a CR032 battery, providing a battery life of up to 1.5 years. They are also very easy to replace—simply locate the notch on the side, pry open the back cover, and replace the battery.

          Q:Does it have a silent mode?

          A:The product itself does not make any sound automatically. It will only play a sound when it is within Bluetooth range and you tap “Play a Sound.” Under normal circumstances, it remains in silent mode.

          Q:Does it work internationally?

          A:Using MFi certification, you can track your items anytime through Apple’s global network of devices with this smart item locator.

          Q:Does it have a low battery indicator?

          A:When the battery is low, you can see it in the Find My app, which shows a battery indicator.

          Product Description

          Apple Find My Global Tracking Network： CREASO Tracker Tag works exclusively with iOS Apple Find My, using a global network of hundreds of millions of Apple devices. It enables secure, anonymous, long-distance item tracking with no SIM card or monthly fees required Precise Nearby Item Finding with Loud Alert： Within Bluetooth range (up to ~60m/200ft), trigger a loud built-in buzzer up to 100dB to quickly locate nearby items. The Find My app helps you easily pinpoint your keys, wallet, luggage, or backpack in seconds Instant Left-Behind Alerts and Lost Mode: Receive immediate notifications on your iPhone when your item is left behind or disconnected. Activate Lost Mode to securely display contact information so nearby Apple devices can help return your lost item Ultra-Long Battery Life with Replaceable Battery： Powered by a low-energy chipset and replaceable CR2032 battery, offering up to 2 years of use depending on conditions. Comes pre-installed with 4 batteries plus 2 extra backup batteries (6 total in box). No charging needed—just replace when required for continuous tracking Privacy-First Encryption Protection: All location data is transmitted through Apple’s Find My network with end-to-end encryption and anonymous identifiers. Your location history is never stored or shared, ensuring complete privacy and security Waterproof and Reliable Build: The key finders designed for protection against dust, rain,etc. Built for everyday durability, making it ideal for travel, outdoor use, and securing essentials like keys, bags, and luggage Easy One-Tap Setup and Family Sharing (At least iOS 17): Simple pairing via the pre-installed Find My app—no additional software required. Supports sharing with up to 5 people, allowing family or trusted users to help track shared items effortlessly
